entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Oh, hello David? I'm a bit lost here. I ordered a jersey a while ago, and... well, I finally opened it, and it's the wrong size.
I can certainly look into that for you. What specifically is the issue with the fit?
It's just... it's way too tight. I don't think I can even ride in it. The website was a little confusing. I was hoping I could exchange it for a different size. Can't you just help me with this?
Of course, I'm happy to help you with an exchange. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, I think so. It's... VF-98752. I'm sorry, I know I've had it for a little while. I hope it's not too late.
No problem at all. Let me pull up that order. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the jersey. It looks like it was delivered 46 days ago.
Let me just confirm our policy here... Yes, you're well within the 90-day return window. We can absolutely get that return started for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! I was so worried I was stuck with a jersey that was too tight. Thank you so much.
You're very welcome. Since you wanted a different size, I'll process this as an exchange. What size did you need?
A Large would be perfect. The Medium was just the wrong size for me.

Excellent. I've put in the exchange for a size Large. I've also just emailed you a pre-paid return label for the Medium jersey. Just send that back to us, and we'll get the new one shipped out. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help, David. Thank you!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
